steps.caption: Review Widgets. Yelp is excluded, stated once on the page rather than in every filter menu.
Two columns, and no dashed create tile. New widget in the header is the one front door, and it opens a screen of its own.
Viewing a widget is an overlay: the preview and the embed snippet, with the list still behind it.
Editing an existing widget stays on this screen. The stepper says where you are, because step indicators are the progress.
A live feed keeps pulling in new matching reviews. Individual ones can still be excluded by hand.
List, carousel or JSON feed. These three are the only widget types the source documents evidence.
Design is a small set of discrete choices, with a live preview underneath.
One fact per row with a hairline between, not three facts glued into a sentence with interpuncts. Every date is absolute and in the same format the page header uses.
Destructive actions ask in a dialog, never as a red panel inside the card. A red panel reads as an error that has happened rather than a question being asked, and it reflowed the grid around it.
